prompt: Write a fun, conversational story of about 8,000–10,000 words based on this idea: a petite woman keeps pace drink-for-drink with her big former college buddy in a lakeside cabin, blacking out and later yelling “the bench fell over” hours before it actually does. Dive into her hazy memories, playful group dynamics, and the eerie possibility that she’s psychic when blackout drunk. Set the scene in a misty, rustic cabin, include a couple of flashbacks to college pranks, weave in comedic chaos and mounting tension, and explore her unreliable narration. Make sure to highlight her inner doubts, build suspense leading up to the “vision,” and end with a surprising twist about what really happened.
